name: TextWork
description: Candidates text to apply, and an agent screens them over SMS, asks your qualifying questions, schedules interviews and hands recruiters a clean summary. It works after hours and over weekends (founder-stated). It plugs into SmartRecruiters or your ATS (company-stated). Target: "teams that hire at volume and cannot call every applicant: hourly and frontline roles, skilled trades, staffing desks" (founder-stated). Pricing: Starter $99/mo, Growth $199/mo, Enterprise (homepage). Homepage counters (rendered 20 Oct): "202+ jobsites", "277,459+ text messages exchanged", "11,693+ applicants screened" (company-stated). ~8,000 estimated users (founder-stated). Founded Jan 2018, US, founder Brian (1.6k X followers).

mentions.indieAngle: Polish blue-collar and Ukrainian-worker hiring runs on phone calls and WhatsApp. Build "aplikuj SMS-em/WhatsAppem" pre-screening (availability, permits, driving licence, start date) for agencje pracy tymczasowej (temp agencies) and logistics warehouses, priced per site.

whyItPrints: Staffing desks and field-service companies lose applicants who wait days for a call back. SMS screening is plumbing between job boards, the ATS and a recruiter's calendar. Only 2 active subscriptions, so this is a couple of enterprise contracts (my read of the numbers), very concentrated.
